items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Commerce MCP Tools for POS Shift and Cash Management
items.description: This feature provides reusable Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools for Store Commerce shift and cash management, exposing Commerce capabilities as structured actions that customers, partners, and developers can compose into agentic experiences. The tools enable agentic experiences to list a store's registers and drawers; scan current shift status, including open, suspended, blind-closed, and invalid shifts; list shifts opened in a requested period, including those now closed; retrieve structured detail for one shift, covering lifecycle, operational, tender, cash, tax, and transaction totals; return X-report content for an open shift and Z-report content for a closed shift; open one shift on the signed-in worker's register; blind close, fully close, or declare counted tenders and then close an eligible shift; record a starting amount, float entry, tender removal, or tender declaration; and review, reconcile, or undo cash reconciliation records. Shift detail and X-report content are available while a shift is still open, so a host experience can apply its own thresholds to what is returned and alert a manager during trading rather than after close. All operations execute through existing Commerce shift, cash, and permission logic. Responses return structured data hosts can present as status, cash positions, blockers, and next steps. Setup is performed by an administrator or implementation partner. Customers configure the host surface, authorize the agent to call the tools from an authenticated Point of Sale session, and maintain existing drawer assignments, cash policy, and Point of Sale permissions in Commerce headquarters.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations
items.description: Bullseye routing with user groups enables a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible representatives as conversation wait time increases. Rather than assigning from a fixed pool or waiting for overflow rules to trigger, this approach progressively widens availability in concentric rings—starting with the best-fit representatives and expanding outward as needed. Administrators configure this scenario by associating user groups with a queue and defining wait time thresholds for each tier. For example: 0–30 seconds: Assign to Tier 1 specialists (primary user group) 30–60 seconds: Expand to include Tier 2 representatives (secondary user group) 60+ seconds: Include all available representatives (tertiary user group) Conversation orchestration monitors each conversation's wait time and automatically expands the eligible pool when thresholds are reached. This process ensures that customers are matched with the most qualified available representative, while preventing excessive wait times when the primary pool is at capacity. Key benefits: Best-fit first : Prioritizes the most qualified representatives before expanding to broader pools. Automatic expansion : No manual intervention required—wait time thresholds trigger expansion automatically. Configurable tiers : Define as many user group tiers as needed, with custom wait time thresholds for each. Seamless integration : Works alongside other conversation orchestration scenarios like dynamic priority escalation and overflow based on representative availability.

The actions include offering a direct callback to the caller, sending them to voicemail, transferring the call to another queue or external number, or ending the call.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Orchestrate conversation distribution with natural language playbooks
items.description: Conversation orchestration in Dynamics 365 Contact Center keeps every conversation actively managed throughout its lifecycle, from initiation through resolution. Instead of applying fixed rules at different stages of a conversation journey, conversation orchestration monitors each conversation as conditions evolve, like wait time increases, fast-filling queues, or service representatives going offline, and responds automatically with the right action. For example, administrators can define the intent using natural-language playbooks as follows: "If a premium customer waits for more than three minutes and no senior agents are available, increase their priority and offer a callback." Conversation orchestration then handles how it's run in real time. You can configure playbooks per scenario through guided templates that keep instructions focused and reliable. Built-in validation catches conflicts before anything goes live, so that you confidently publish changes without needing to test every edge case manually. The key capabilities are as follows: Dynamic priority escalation : In traditional systems, conversation priority is typically set once, at entry, and never revisited. This means a customer who has been waiting for 10 minutes competes for the same expert as another customer who has just arrived, and a conversation that’s transferred mid-journey resets to whatever the new queue's default priority is. Dynamic priority escalation fixes this by continuously re-evaluating priority as the conversation progresses. You define the conditions such as wait time thresholds, queue transfers, customer tier, or other context and conversation orchestration adjusts priority automatically throughout the conversation lifecycle. High-value or long-waiting customers move forward without anyone watching the queue manually. Overflow handling across multiple conditions : Conversation orchestration supports a broader set of business triggered overflow conditions, allowing organizations to respond intelligently as queue conditions change. Administrators can define actions when a queue is outside operating hours, when all representatives in a queue are signed out or unavailable, when queue wait time exceeds a defined threshold, or when the number of waiting conversations surpasses a specified limit. Depending on the situation, orchestration can automatically offer callbacks, route conversations to alternate queues, expand assignment eligibility, notify supervisors, or deliver contextual customer messages. This ensures customers are never left waiting without a defined path forward. Admins can also configure overflow handling for direct inward dial calls now, when reps are not available or don't accept the calls. Assign to a previously engaged or preferred representative : Customers often need to repeat information when they are connected to a new representative for every interaction. Conversation orchestration helps maintain continuity by reconnecting customers with previously engaged or preferred representatives whenever possible. Assignment decisions take into account historical interactions, queue membership alignment, representative availability, and workload capacity. For asynchronous conversations, organizations can choose to honor representative presence status and active conversation limits before reconnecting customers, ensuring returning conversations are assigned only when the preferred representative has capacity to engage. When the preferred or previously engaged representative is unavailable, conversations seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified representative. This reduces customer effort, improves resolution efficiency, and delivers a more personalized support experience. Bullseye routing : Finding the right representative often requires balancing expertise with response times. Bullseye routing enables organizations to gradually expand the pool of eligible representatives when a conversation isn't assigned within a defined timeframe. Administrators can define progressive routing rings that begin with the most qualified representatives and then expand to broader groups based on skills, proficiency levels, teams, or other business criteria. This approach maximizes the likelihood of connecting customers with the best-qualified representative while ensuring conversations don't wait indefinitely for a specific resource. These capabilities are the first in a broad and growing set of orchestration scenarios that conversation orchestration will support across the full conversation lifecycle, spanning overflow management, priority handling, assignment strategies, in-conversation messaging, and escalation. Each new capability builds on the same natural-language playbook foundation, so organizations can adopt new scenarios without rebuilding what they have already configured. Business Value: Traditional automatic conversation distribution systems rely on complex rules and static configuration that are difficult to maintain and can't adapt as conditions change throughout the conversation lifecycle. Unified routing with its new AI-powered conversation orchestration uses the power of agentic AI to continuously monitor events throughout the entire conversation lifecycle and responds with the right action when required. This is a shift from a static system to an orchestration layer that remains active and intelligent from the moment a conversation arrives in a queue until it's resolved. The new feature reduces administrative complexity and helps deliver more flexible customer experiences at scale, even under fluctuating demand. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Handle waiting conversations when queues close or become unstaffed
items.description: This capability enhances queue handling by intelligently detecting two key scenarios where conversations would otherwise remain unserved: Queue transitions to out-of-operating hours : The system continuously monitors active conversations that entered a queue before closing time. If the queue transitions to out-of-operating hours while conversations are still waiting, it automatically applies admin-defined overflow actions. Customers can be guided to leave a voicemail, request a callback, or be transferred to another available queue, ensuring a smooth end-of-day experience without manual intervention. No service representatives are signed in : The system evaluates real-time representative availability. If all representatives assigned to a queue are signed out, it immediately triggers the configured fallback action instead of waiting for in-queue overflow timers. This is especially valuable in scenarios such as mass logout events, unexpected breaks, or holidays not captured in operating hours. Administrators configure both scenarios using natural language prompts in conversation orchestration, enabling fine-grained control over queue behavior. This ensures customers are always routed to the best possible outcome, even when direct support is unavailable. Business Value: This capability ensures customers are never left waiting when representatives aren't available. Whether a queue transitions to be out-of-operating hours or all support representatives are logged out, the system proactively routes conversations to configured fallback options such as voicemail, callback, or alternative queues. Organizations benefit from reduced wait times and lower abandonment, improved customer satisfaction during peak load or unexpected staffing gaps, and a more predictable service experience regardless of representative availability. At the same time, this eliminates the need for manual queue draining or extended shifts, helping protect service representative wellbeing while maintaining consistent service levels. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Assign conversation to expert who engaged with the customer previously
items.description: Assign to a previously engaged or preferred expert leverages historical interaction context, queue membership alignment, and expert availability, to ensure customers are reconnected with experts who already understand their issue. When the previous or preferred expert is unavailable, assignments seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified expert, preserving service levels and reliability. This capability reduces repeat explanations, accelerates resolution times, and improves customer satisfaction, helping businesses lower cost to serve while delivering more consistent, personalized support experiences at scale. Administrators define assignment logic using natural language-based playbooks in conversation orchestration, with configurable lookback period to determine the time range until when the system should look for a previously engaged expert. For asynchronous conversations, administrators can also choose to reconnect customers with the same expert by checking the expert’s current presence status and honoring active conversation limits, ensuring returning conversations are assigned only when the expert has capacity to engage. Business Value: By automatically assigning customers to a previous or preferred expert, you deliver faster, more personalized support. By routing repeat or follow up conversations to the most recent or preferred expert within configurable time windows, you reduce customer repetition, improve continuity, and accelerate resolution. When the previous expert is unavailable, the system intelligently falls back to the next best qualified expert, ensuring service levels are maintained. This leads to lower handling times, higher customer satisfaction, and improved expert efficiency. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design POS screen layouts in a modern browser designer
items.description: Create and preview POS screen layouts in headquarters with a modern web designer that simplifies configuration and reduces design iterations. The Screen layout designer is modernized as a React-based web experience embedded in Commerce headquarters, with a JSON-based layout backbone replacing the legacy XML representation. The feature applies to Store Commerce point of sale (POS). The modernization includes these core capabilities: Visual layout and button-grid authoring: Arrange and resize supported POS components on a drag-and-drop canvas, configure properties, and edit associated button grids and POS operation mappings in a unified experience. Live preview: Inspect layouts and their associated button-grid operations while designing, and preview supported device sizes and orientations without distributing every design iteration to stores. Existing layout migration: Bring existing screen layouts and button-grid configurations into the modern designer rather than recreate them from scratch. Reusable configuration: Reuse layout templates with store-specific overrides to reduce the need to maintain duplicate layouts. Modern usability: Work with contextual properties, familiar Fluent UI controls, and inline validation. Administrators enable or disable the modern designer through feature management in headquarters. Authorized users open Retail and Commerce > Channel setup > POS setup > POS > Screen layouts , select a layout, and open the designer. They configure the layout and button grids, inspect the preview, and save changes to headquarters. Administrators distribute the saved configuration to stores through the existing Commerce data distribution process. Previewing changes does not replace the distribution needed to update Store Commerce. Setup is performed by a Commerce administrator, who enables the feature, grants appropriate headquarters permissions, and manages layout assignments and distribution. No separate ClickOnce designer installation or Copilot license is required for manual design.

items.description: Expense Agent helps employees keep expense submissions moving when an original receipt is unavailable. It guides employees through providing the information needed to support the expense, generates supporting documentation from those details, and enables them to continue the reimbursement process without manually creating replacement documentation. Benefits • Provides a guided process for documenting expenses when receipts are lost or unavailable. • Reduces manual effort by automatically generating supporting documentation from employee-provided information. • Creates a more consistent lost-receipt process for employees and finance teams.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Split your expenses
items.description: Split a single expense across multiple allocations so costs are accurately assigned to the appropriate expense user, project, department, customer, or expense category. Expense Agent helps you define the split and ensures the allocations add up to the original expense amount. Each allocation is recorded separately for reporting and accounting while remaining linked to the original expense. Benefits • Accurately distribute expenses across multiple users, projects, departments, customers, or expense categories. • Define expense splits with help from Expense Agent while keeping allocations aligned with the original expense total. • Maintain separate allocation records for reporting and accounting while preserving the connection to the original expense.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
items.description: We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint. Generate document from form (Preview) allows customers to create documents from a template by mapping data inputs to predefined template fields. Documents are generated as part of an automated flow and stored in SharePoint. This capability supports scenarios such as creating contracts, invoices, letters, or reports using structured templates and form-driven inputs. The action works by mapping input data to template fields and returns the generated document along with file metadata such as location and status.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
items.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Insider risk management for agents
items.description: As AI agents become deeply embedded in enterprise ecosystems, they are evolving beyond simple tools or workflows into a digital workforce. These agents can interpret intent, access and manipulate enterprise data, execute actions and even make real-time decisions. In many ways, they operate like human insiders only with machine-speed data processing capabilities. To govern and protect these agents effectively, Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is being expanded to agents, with specific indicators and insider risk score built for agents based on agentic activities. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for refining query filters for Confluence Copilot connectors
items.description: This feature enhances and standardizes query filtering across both Confluence Cloud and Confluence On-premises connectors. For Confluence Cloud connector, it introduces simplified options to filter pages by page id, creation date/time and last update date/time, helping improve productivity and reduce human errors. For Confluence On-premises connector, it adds support for advanced CQL-based filtering, enabling more complex and flexible filtering scenarios.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Autonomously generate quotes and drive sales with Sales Development Agent
items.description: Sales Development Agent (SDA) can take leads from qualified opportunities to closed deals. Key capabilities include: Generating quotes through D365S as well as 1P/3P systems and sharing them with customers to company branded templates. Connectivity to quoting and transaction systems managed through Agent 365 MCP registry. Answer questions about the quote and adjust details based on customer feedback. Facilitate customers completing self-service transactions. Escalating to human sellers when customers are blocked and need human intervention. Configuration through interactive chat experience with each agent instance.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Connectors, and Agents for US Government customers
items.description: We are introducing new Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Copilot Connectors, and Copilot Agents for US Government customers across GCC Moderate, GCC High, and DoD environments. These reports will provide administrators with organization-level and user-level insights to help them understand usage and adoption of these Copilot capabilities.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
items.description: Configure retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory to help preserve historical versions of memory items for security, compliance, and investigation scenarios. Copilot memory includes saved memories and details inferred from chat history that enable more personalized and context-aware Copilot experiences. Copilot memory items are stored in a hidden folder in the user’s Exchange mailbox. This capability will enable retention and versioning support for inactive memory items so that administrators can maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory continues to be managed by the Copilot experience.

items.title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
items.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

items.title: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
items.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
items.description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts with the user's own account and permissions at the third-party service, and every create, update, or delete action requires the user's explicit confirmation before it runs. Admins can view each connector's read and write/delete tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center and disable connectors that don't meet their organization's policies.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business
items.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open browser tabs and YouTube videos directly from the Edge side pane

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC
items.description: We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. This gives administrators a more centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spend across usage-based AI workloads while retaining Copilot Studio cost management capabilities in the Power Platform admin center. With this update, administrators can bring supported Copilot Studio environments and agents under Cost Management spending policies. Resource-based policies for environments and agents are the first planned scopes, with broader user and group policy support planned for a later phase. Furthermore, this update will introduce cost data into cost management and agent registry for AI services and agents built on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Cowork, Microsoft Copilot Studio agents).
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Biometric authentication
items.description: Voice biometric authentication delivers business value by reducing fraud and agent operating costs in contact centers. Voice-based verification improves identity assurance shortens call durations reduces customer service rep effort and enable secure self-service transactions. At the same time, it improves customer experience and scalability by authenticating callers naturally as they speak. This enables consistent, risk-based security across high call volumes without adding authentication friction or process complexity.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics foundation for historical reporting
items.description: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expenses from credit card feeds
items.description: Expense Agent now supports creating expenses from imported credit card transaction feeds or automatically reconcile with them if the expense was created earlier. Key capabilities include: Import credit card transaction data and review it in the web and mobile apps. Automatically create expenses from imported card transactions. Match imported transactions to existing expenses, where applicable. Reduce duplicate data entry by leveraging transaction details already captured from credit card feeds. Credit card transactions are manually imported into the Credit Cards Feeds from the file. The system processes the imported transactions and identifies transactions eligible for expense creation. Expense Agent creates draft expenses using transaction information such as merchant, date, and amount. You can review the suggested expenses, and complete any required information before you submit. Matching capabilities help associate imported transactions with existing expenses, which helps avoid duplicates and improves reconciliation.

items.title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
items.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes. Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place. Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes. The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account. Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and shared mailbox support will follow in later releases.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Universal connector for self-service omnichannel agents
items.description: Bring Microsoft AI to the contact center platform of your choice with the Universal Connector. Organizations can now integrate Microsoft self-service voice and chat agents with virtually any contact center using a simple API-based approach. The Universal Connector enables seamless handoff from AI agents to human representatives while preserving the full conversation context, ensuring a connected and personalized customer experience across every interaction. This flexibility allows organizations to modernize at their own pace by bringing AI-powered experiences to their existing contact center investments without requiring a costly migration or platform replacement. Whether supporting voice or chat experiences, customers can quickly extend intelligent self-service capabilities while maintaining continuity across AI and human-assisted engagements.

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Tools
items.description: Tools are building blocks that let your agent interact with external systems. Tools expand what your agent can do, and your agent can perform various actions in response to user requests or autonomous triggers. Each tool represents a specific capability that your agent can perform. For example, you can equip your agent with tools that perform tasks like: Send emails by using the Office 365 Outlook connector Check the current weather conditions and forecasts Read and write data from Dataverse Read and post messages to Teams

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Historical analytics
items.description: Contact Center historical analytics provides out-of-box historical reporting for Dynamics 365 Contact Center, built on a shared analytics foundation. It moves reporting from heavier workload-specific Power BI models toward a shared analytics foundation with conformed facts, shared dimensions, pre-built aggregations, and common definitions across conversations, sessions, agents, queues, channels, CSAT, handle time, and operational KPIs. Customers can continue using out-of-box Power BI reports while gaining extensibility through Fabric, Direct Lake, SQL, Spark, and custom lakehouse models.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics for historical reporting
items.description: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent mobile app
items.description: The Expense Agent mobile app for Dynamics 365 Business Central extends expense capture to iOS and Android mobile devices by enabling employees to submit receipts directly from their phone or using native share functionality. Employees can take a photo of a receipt with their phone camera or select an existing image or document, and share it with Expense Agent mobile app. They can also capture multiple receipts directly from the mobile app and process them automatically. The Expense Agent mobile app processes the input, extracts relevant information, and automatically creates expense entries without requiring additional manual steps. The mobile experience provides a full-featured interface aligned with the web app, allowing employees to review, modify, and complete expense details before submission, but also full approval experience. Employees can manage individual expenses and entire expense reports directly from their mobile device, ensuring flexibility and control regardless of location. The key Dynamics 365 Business Central expense management capabilities, such as capture, validation, review, and submission are available on the Expense Agent mobile app supporting end-to-end workflows in a consistent and user-friendly way. The Expense Agent mobile app also works in offline mode where you can capture your receipts even if you are not connected to your environment, and once when you have an internet connection, agent will process all of them. The Expense Agent mobile app was in testing mode, but now it is in public preview and you can download it from app stores. This mobile app was in testing mode, but now you can download it from stores.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
items.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
items.description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
items.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
items.description: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on Microsoft Copilot Harness
items.description: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.

items.title: Power Automate: AI-assisted UI Automation repair
items.description: A new agentic debug run feature will be available in the flow designer. The UI automation repair interface launches while the flow is running, validating each selector used in the flow. It then proposes a new selector in case an existing one does not work as expected, after the user captures the respective element for reference.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot app mode handoffs
items.description: The Chat experience in the Copilot app will suggest a better-fit mode based on the user's prompt, if applicable. For example, it will suggest Cowork or other supported modes as they become available. Users will see a suggestion card after they send a prompt in Chat, with an explanation of the better-fit mode and an option for the user to switch to the suggested mode. Their chat conversation will be attached to the prompt in the new mode to maintain context.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in DoD
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to the Microsoft 365 Department of Defense (DoD) environment, providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the DoD environment.

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Knowledge
items.description: Knowledge sources ground your agent's responses in enterprise data. When you add knowledge sources, agents can use enterprise data from Power Platform, Dynamics 365 data, websites, and external systems. By using knowledge sources, your agents can provide relevant information and insights for your customers. You can incorporate knowledge sources into agents during their initial creation, or add them after the agent is created. Published agents that contain knowledge use the configured knowledge sources to ground the published agent. You can incorporate knowledge at the agent level, in the Knowledge page, or at the topic level, with a generative answers node in an agent topic.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
items.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
items.description: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Search Helps You Discover People
items.description: Now Copilot Search can return matching people for your broader people search queries. Allowing you to discover, disambiguate, and explore known and new people to contact. Discover Whether you're looking for people with a specific skill like "Project leadership" or "Artificial Intelligence" Copilot Search can help you explore potential contacts through the People data source. Disambiguate When there are multiple people matching in exact name, email, or alias Copilot Search will help you disambiguate through a new carousel on the main results page alongside other relevant results.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Expand localization in LATAM countries for Argentina
items.description: With the release of Argentina, we are finalizing the LATAM expansion. Out-of-the-box localization is now available for 14 countries in the region through the cross-LATAM localization framework, in addition to Brazil and Mexico. The country localization indicated below is provisional and may change prior to general availability. Additionally, not all of the following capabilities might be available for preview. The Argentina-specific scope for this release includes: Sales tax (VAT and provincial taxes): tax determination and calculation, import of taxpayer registers (padrones), and certificate of tax situation for customers. Withholding tax (vendor payments): withholding tax determination and calculation. Regulatory reporting: Argentina tax reports moved to Electronic Reporting (ER). ARCA VAT reports required by IVA Simple, covering sales, purchases, imports, other fiscal debit and credit items, withholdings, and perceptions, to register VAT operations monthly and submit the VAT return through Portal IVA SICORE : National Withholding and Perception Tax Transactions TXT/excel file SIRE (SUSS) : SUSS Withholdings (Retenciones de Seguridad Social) TXT/excel file. SIFERE : Withholding tax (Retenciones) TXT/excel - Perceptions (Percepciones) TXT/excel - Bank Collections Recaudaciones Bancarias) TXT/excel - Customs Perceptions (Percepciones Aduaneras) TXT/excel SIRCAR : Gross Income Tax Withholdings TXT /excel file. Gross Income Tax Perceptions TXT /excel file. E-ARCIBA : Gross Income Tax Withholdings/Tax Collections (Perceptions) file. ARBA Tax Collection Agents : IIBB Perceptions (Percepciones) TXT/excel file. IIBB Withholdings (Retenciones) TXT/excel file. Electronic invoicing: Out of scope for the preview release

items.title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
items.description: Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh without having to build it yourself. Depending on the data source, authentication may be required.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint Site Builder
items.description: This feature enables users to easily create new SharePoint sites with Copilot. Users can review and confirm a clear site plan before Copilot builds the site.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and collaborate more efficiently while keeping sharing within organizational controls.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.description: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
items.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning issues, or compliance risk, simplifying high-volume, structured document workflows across the organization.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge. Updated March 20, 2026: We have paused release of this feature temporarily and will announce new release timelines soon. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Manage policy strictness to enforce governance policies
items.description: This feature introduces policy strictness control, enabling organizations to define how rigorously each governance policy evaluates and flags potential violations in outgoing emails. Governance policies serve as real-time guardrails, ensuring communications adhere to business, legal, and compliance standards before they are sent to customers. With this enhancement, supervisors can configure the strictness level for each policy. Lower strictness settings apply more lenient enforcement, reducing false positives and allowing borderline scenarios to pass, while higher settings perform more rigorous checks to identify subtle or potentially risky violations. This flexibility allows organizations to align policy enforcement with their compliance requirements and risk tolerance. All policies are set to medium strictness by default, providing a balanced level of enforcement. Organizations can then adjust strictness levels per policy depending on the nature of the rule. For example, highly sensitive policies, such as those related to data protection or regulatory compliance, can be configured with stricter enforcement, while policies focused on tone or content guidance can be set to be more lenient to avoid unnecessary disruptions. At runtime, the governance policies use the configured strictness level to determine how policy violations are flagged when outgoing emails are evaluated. This ensures that enforcement is consistent and adaptable across different policy types and business scenarios. By enabling strictness control at the policy level, organizations can fine-tune governance enforcement without modifying the underlying policy definitions, helping balance compliance protection, agent productivity, and a seamless customer communication experience. Business Value: Take control of how your governance policies handle outbound email violations. With adjustable strictness levels, you can cut down on false positives when flexibility matters or apply tighter controls for sensitive situations. This balance helps you build confidence in AI-driven enforcement while keeping your policies aligned with your risk tolerance, compliance requirements, and business goals. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Personalize outreach emails generated by Sales Qualification Agent
items.description: Define outreach scenario/goal in natural language. Choose desired call-to-action to drive next steps. Provide subject line guidance: fixed suggestion or style recommendation. Set message length and brevity targets. Specify tone rules, including name-usage limits and preferred terminology. Configure brand language and voice guardrails: approved phrases and banned words. Set formatting preferences: bullets, paragraph length, and maximum bullet count. Business Value: This feature expands the Sales Qualification Agent outreach by letting teams define the outreach purpose, brand-aligned tone (matching both company voice and seller style), the call-to-action, and key messaging preferences proven to resonate with prospects. The result is more relevant, consistent communication that drives higher response rates and, in turn, improves lead qualification rates. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Deploy multiple Sales Qualification Agents in a single environment
items.description: Segment-specific qualification : Each agent operates with its own ideal customer profile, knowledge sources, templates, and consent settings, ensuring qualification conversations reflect the nuances of each product, region, or team. Intelligent lead routing : The system evaluates incoming leads against agent selection criteria and assigns ownership based on configured priority, ensuring predictable and conflict-free lead management. A fallback agent handles leads that don't match any specialized criteria, ensuring no lead goes unprocessed. Exclusive engagement with coordinated handoff : Only one agent engages a lead at any time. When a lead's interest shifts to another product or segment, the system hands off with full context to the appropriate agent. Shared knowledge foundation : Agents can leverage common company-level knowledge while maintaining their own specialized sources, ensuring consistent answers across the organization. Supervisor oversight and governance : A centralized dashboard enables supervisors to monitor agent activity, reassign leads, and track the full qualification journey across all agents. Business Value: Multi-agent configuration in Sales Qualification Agents enables sales organizations to deploy agents aligned to distinct product lines, regions, or sales teams, each with its own qualification criteria, knowledge sources, and engagement approach. Multi-agent configuration ensures exclusive lead ownership, coordinates handoffs when context shifts, and provides sales managers with visibility across agents. This targeted approach mirrors real-world sales structures, eliminates duplicate outreach, accelerates qualification, and scales coverage without additional seller headcount. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Modify and override submitted evaluations
items.description: This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired. While completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity, supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified, such as incorrect AI predictions or errors in manual assessments. In edit mode, supervisors can update evaluation responses, adjust scores, and refine comments to reflect an accurate assessment. This ensures that evaluation records represent the final, validated view of agent performance and interaction quality. The capability is available across AI-assisted, AI agent-generated, and manual evaluations, providing a consistent correction experience. To maintain control and governance, only authorized users with supervisory permissions can perform overrides. All changes are tracked through audit signals, including who made the edit and when, and overridden evaluations are clearly flagged. This ensures full transparency for reporting, compliance, and downstream reviews. Business Value: Enables Quality Managers or users with privileges to correct completed evaluations when inaccuracies arise from AI predictions or human review errors. This ensures evaluation outcomes accurately reflect real-world context and business standards. By introducing controlled human-in-the-loop oversight with full auditability, organizations can confidently scale automated and manual evaluations while maintaining trust, transparency, and governance. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: IVR capabilities - Equip voice agents with custom voice
items.description: Secure a voice talent that will represent the voice of your brand. After obtaining explicit consent , gaining Limited Access approval through Microsoft's Responsible AI practices, and building a custom voice model , it's time to integrate with Dynamics 365 Contact Center. In the Copilot Service admin center, create a connection between Dynamics 365 and Azure. Navigate to Channels > Custom AI Voices > Connect custom voice . You'll be prompted through a series of cascading dropdown boxes to select the speech resource and custom voice model to connect with. After the connection is established, you can create a voice channel for self-service and use the custom voice, like any portfolio voice. Business Value: Brand identity extends beyond visuals like logo, color, and typography, into voice. Custom neural voice enables enterprises to create a distinctive, natural sounding synthetic voice for contact centers. By training on approved human speech samples, organizations can deliver a natural sounding, one-of-a-kind brand voice that preserves brand continuity, strengthens customer recognition, and elevates voice-based experiences across AI-powered agents and telephony interactions. items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
items.description: AI agents in Business Central Business Central introduces AI agents to help users automate repetitive tasks and make business processes more intelligent and efficient. These agents act as specialized assistants that understand context, handle structured data, and collaborate with users to complete end-to-end workflows. For example, the Sales Order Agent simplifies order creation by transforming natural language or email instructions into complete sales documents, while the Payables Agent streamlines vendor invoice processing by extracting key details from incoming invoices and matching them to purchase orders—all reducing manual effort and freeing users to focus on higher-value work. The agent runtime that powers these built-in agents provides core capabilities that enable the use of agentic AI within Business Central. AI agents are defined, configured, activated, and run directly inside the familiar Business Central environment—leveraging the same security model, administration tools, and user experience as the rest of the product. Results are displayed in-context, with intuitive navigation to related data and entities, allowing users to control the agents through the interface they already know. This consistency dramatically reduces the learning curve, builds trust, and ensures efficiency when working with AI agents. The agent runtime ensures that every step taken by an agent is traceable and operates strictly within the access boundaries (permissions) assigned during configuration. It provides a timeline view of all agent activities, allowing users to review what happened and why—enabling a true human-in-the-loop experience. The runtime can also memorize relevant data during execution, use it in subsequent steps, and request additional instructions in natural language when user input is needed. It helps ensure that sensitive operations always require explicit user review and consent, supporting full transparency and control. Business Central business processes are inherently multistep, stateful, and financially consequential. The agent layer must be able to interact with a broad set of ERP capabilities and data, sequence operations with a high degree of accuracy across dependent steps, handle the data respecting permissions, company, environment, and tenant boundaries, provide a contextual audit trail, and keep humans in the loop. Business Central agentic strategy intentionally separates deep, well controlled, in-context and transparent execution within the product from cross-system orchestration. Business Central agents form the foundational layer inside the product, exposing well-defined agent capabilities that in the future will be possible to surface as MCP tools and consume by Declarative Agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365. This layered approach enables Business Central-tuned, transparent, managed execution at the ERP core processes, while allowing higher-level Declarative Agents to orchestrate end-to-end business processes across products. Designing agents The new in-product experience for designing agents that automate Business Central processes is made available with AI Development Toolkit for Business Central. The experience offers a low-risk environment for envisioning and prototyping new AI agents tailored to your own business scenarios—extending the same agent runtime capabilities used by built-in Business Central agents. Built for rapid iteration, the designing experience lets you create and refine custom agents using natural language instructions, define their behavior, test agent profiles and permissions, and safely experiment with Business Central data in a sandbox environment. This approach empowers partner personas like consultants, product owners, and domain experts, as well as developers and even power users, to explore new scenarios, validate ideas, and build confidence in their agents before moving to production. Whether you aim to automate repetitive business processes, streamline data processing, or deliver proactive insights, the agent design experience gives you the tools to bring your vision to life. Agent instructions At the core of every agent are its goals and instructions, defined in natural language. Writing agent instructions is similar to writing prompts for large language models, so you can apply general prompt-writing best practices—and even use tools like Copilot to optimize them. The agent design experience includes a simple editor to help you define, refine, and test these instructions efficiently. Invoking your agent You can invoke your agent by manually creating a task for it. When doing so, you can include an additional message that provides specific details or context to complement the agent’s core instructions. Although the ability to design your own agents is in public preview, there aren't yet any built-in integrations to automatically trigger these custom agents based on incoming emails, events, or scheduled recurrences (this can be done by professional developers using the APIs available in the AI Development Toolkit). However, you can simulate these scenarios by including the email header and body in the task message to mimic incoming emails, or by manually triggering the agent to emulate event, UI action, or time-based runs. Troubleshooting When running the agent tasks in the designing experience, you can access detailed diagnostic views to help you understand and tune the agent execution. Since an agent’s decisions depend on its instructions, available data, and language model reasoning, you can review execution logs to see its inputs, reasoning process, and outputs. This helps you identify where uncertainty occurred and why specific decisions were made to adjust your agent instructions. Importing and exporting agents To make it easy to back up or move custom agents across sandbox environments, the in-product experience allows you to import and export agent definitions. These definitions are stored as simple JSON files containing properties such as agent identity, instructions, assigned profiles, and permissions. We recommend storing these files in a source control system like GitHub to track changes and maintain version history. Responsible AI Agents built using the agent design experience adhere to Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, helping you ensure agent compliance, fairness, and safety. Billing As with the built-in Sales Order and Payables agents, custom agents consume Copilot credits as they perform their steps. Credits can be provisioned through prepaid or pay-as-you-go models, providing flexible cost management as your AI usage scales. Business Value: Agents in Business Central are AI-powered team assistants that go beyond traditional automation. Unlike static workflows or hard-coded AL logic, agents can interpret high-level business goals expressed in natural language and translate them into actionable steps. They reason over Business Central data, make informed decisions within defined boundaries, and collaborate with users through human-in-the-loop approvals for critical operations. The benefits are substantial: agents reduce manual effort by automating repetitive or complex tasks, allowing users to focus on higher-value activities. They adapt to dynamic business scenarios that can't always be anticipated during development, offering flexibility that traditional automation lacks. Most importantly, agents operate transparently: every action is logged, permissions are rigorously enforced, and users remain in control at all times. This combination of intelligence, adaptability, and accountability makes agents a cornerstone of the next generation of ERP experiences. With the agent design experience, we're taking the first steps toward enabling you to build your own custom Business Central agents. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policy
items.description: Create and enforce policies that prevent risky or noncompliant customer communications. Governance policy checks serve as configurable safeguards that review AI-generated and autonomous email responses before they are sent to customers. These checks enforce business, legal, and regulatory requirements by validating responses for relevance, prohibited content, and sensitive topics. If a response fails a policy check, delivery is blocked and the violation is clearly identified, enabling supervisors to review issues and take actions to improve outcomes. Governance policies are applied consistently across email engagement channels and seamlessly embedded within agent workflows, ensuring uniform enforcement of quality and compliance standards without requiring manual intervention. This approach empowers organizations to scale AI-assisted and autonomous customer engagement with confidence while upholding trust, safety, and governance. Business Value: Governance policies give you control over AI-driven customer interactions. By setting clear, configurable rules, you make sure every response meets your business, legal, and regulatory standards before it reaches customers. This reduces risk, protects your brand, and keeps communication consistent and trustworthy. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup
items.description: You can now configure and run multiple Sales Order Agent instances in a single company. Each instance operates independently with its own mailbox, folder settings, email signature, and processing rules. Each agent instance tracks its own KPI metrics, such as emails received, quotes created, orders created, and time saved. The setup page is restructured to support per-instance configuration, and an upgrade path migrates existing single-instance setups to the new architecture. This change allows organizations to set up separate agents for different sales teams, product lines, or customer segments, each monitoring their own personal or shared mailbox. Improved items search: When a customer requests items, the agent now uses a multi-layer matching strategy: Exact identifier match: direct lookup by item number, vendor item number, GTIN, or cross-reference. Semantic attribute matching: extracts attributes from the customer's message (color, material, size) and ranks candidates by relevance using AI. Broader fuzzy search: falls back to a global item search when direct and attribute-based searches produce no results. Message and attachment relevance: The agent now validates incoming messages and attachments against a detailed relevance model before processing. Messages that fall outside the agent's responsibilities (such as offers to sell, requests for discounts, or attempts to extract internal information) are identified and filtered. A separate relevance check runs on attachments, ensuring that non-sales-related documents don't trigger unnecessary processing. The validation considers the full conversation history and the agent's defined scope to make accurate relevance decisions. Larger attachment files with diagnostics. The maximum number of pages per PDF attachment has been raised from 10 to 50, addressing customer feedback about the agent not reading larger purchase orders. A new cumulative content length limit of 150,000 characters is also enforced across all attachments in a single email (approximately 50K tokens). When an attachment is skipped, Business Central now stores the specific reason directly on the attachment record (page count exceeded, cumulative content length exceeded, attachment count exceeded, unsupported format, or analyze-attachments not enabled). This information is visible on the Attachments page and logged in telemetry, making it straightforward to diagnose why a particular document wasn't processed. Try it out. You can now create tasks for the Sales Order Agent without sending an email. From the agent's setup page, a new Try it out section lets you compose a message by selecting a sender (from your contact or customer list), entering message text, and attaching files. The agent acts like it received a real email. To help you get started quickly, two sample messages are included. One is a text-only message that references items from your catalog, and the other is a message with a sample purchase order attachment. The sample order is generated based on your actual item data, so the agent has realistic content to work with. These samples are particularly useful for first-time setup, demos, and testing agent behavior with specific scenarios without needing to send an actual email. Handling of unknown senders When the agent receives an email from an unregistered email address, you now have three options instead of just one: Create a new contact: register the sender as a new contact (existing behavior) Use another contact once: pick an existing contact from the contact list and link them to this specific task only, without modifying any master data. The override is stored per task message and does not affect future emails. Update an existing contact's email: select an existing contact and update their email address to the sender's address More control over email New configuration options give administrators more control over how the agent interacts with the monitored mailbox: Mark email as read: a new toggle to mark processed emails as read in the mailbox. This works in addition to the custom Processed by Sales Order Agent category, giving users a visual signal in their inbox. Mandatory folder selection: the agent now requires you to select a specific mailbox folder before activation. Previously this was optional and could lead to the agent monitoring an unexpected folder. If in doubt, choose Inbox . Stricter activation validation: trying to activate the agent without a mailbox folder now shows a clear error message instead of allowing activation in an ambiguous state. Prompts as embedded resources. The agent's AI prompts (instructions, item search logic, mail template checks, irrelevance validation) are now shipped as embedded resource files within the app extension package. This change reduces latency on first task processing and makes the prompt structure more transparent for engineering iteration. Business Value: The Sales Order Agent now handles more complex organizational structures and higher volumes with less manual intervention. You can run multiple agent instances in one company, each dedicated to a different team or shared mailbox with independent settings and performance tracking. The agent finds the right items more reliably by understanding product attributes, informal descriptions, and identifiers across multiple matching layers. The agent now processes PDFs up to 50 pages (previously, the limit was 10) and clearly shows why any attachment was skipped. It also filters irrelevant messages before processing, so credits aren't consumed by marketing emails or out-of-scope inquiries. If a customer writes from an unregistered email address, you can link an existing contact to that single task without creating duplicates. You can test the agent directly from the setup page without sending a real email, reducing the time to validate your configuration. Enabled for: Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Resolve customer emails autonomously with AI
items.description: Autonomous email resolution delivers end-to-end handling of customer emails without manual intervention or default case creation. When an email arrives, the system analyzes the request, identifies the underlying intent, and determines whether the information and actions needed to resolve it are available. Using enterprise knowledge, configured business instructions, connectors, and custom agents, the system constructs a resolution dynamically. It generates a response that's context-aware, compliant with business rules, and tailored to the request, then delivers it directly by email—completing the interaction autonomously. If the customer isn't satisfied or the issue can't be resolved automatically, the system creates a case that carries the full conversation context, including customer intent, actions taken, and generated responses. A service representative can then step in without losing context or duplicating work. The capability is delivered through the Case Management Agent. An administrator enables the setting and sets the automation level for each line of business, from fully autonomous resolution to drafting a response for a service representative to review and send. This shifts email handling from a case-first workflow to an intent-driven resolution model, reducing manual effort, improving consistency, and accelerating time to resolution for high-volume customer interactions. Business Value: Autonomous email resolution drives faster, consistent responses and frees service representatives to focus on complex, high-impact issues. It improves customer satisfaction and operational efficiency and scales support without increasing response times and costs by automatically resolving high-volume email inquiries. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Use AI resources for your Copilot extensions
items.description: Using the AI resources provides several benefits: Reduced operational overhead : Avoid the need to handle infrastructure management, updates, monitoring, troubleshooting, or maintenance of custom Azure OpenAI subscriptions. This benefit frees up resources to focus on core business operations and provides value-adding intellectual property (IP) to customers. Simplified onboarding : Quickly integrate AI capabilities into your solutions without having to navigate the complexities of setting up and managing your own Azure OpenAI subscription. Improved reliability : Proactive scaling, throttling, load balancing, and fault tolerance measures ensure consistent performance during peak demand. Enhanced security compliance : Built-in compliance measures and governance, including robust protection from malicious and harmful content, ensure compliance with data residency requirements. This benefit reduces the burden of ensuring regulatory compliance for ISVs. Streamlined experience for customers : Customers get a seamless AI resource management process without maintaining different configurations for separate ISV solutions. This capability also provides a cohesive AI consumption tracking and billing experience for Business Central customers. Customers who use AI resources across multiple AI-enabled solutions built with Business Central customer developer tools for Copilot benefit from a unified approach to AI consumption monitoring and invoicing. They don't need to reconcile multiple invoices or metrics from separate ISVs. For details on billing costs, see AI tools at Message scenarios . For most publishers, the default Business Central AI resources are enough. However, if you need specific models, including fine-tuned models, that the Business Central AI resources don't provide, you can bring your own subscription for customers. In this case, the publisher is responsible for deploying, maintaining, scaling, and securing the service. The publisher also handles billing AI resources to customers. We recommend using the developer toolkit AI resources when you extend Copilot in Business Central. You just need to authenticate with the SetManagedResourceAuthorization method in the AI Module AzureOpenAI codeunit. You also provide your own Azure OpenAI subscription details, but the authentication process doesn't use them. (Update 2026 release wave 1: There's now a new method signature for SetManagedResources that doesn't require you to provide your subscription details anymore. You should use that going forward.) // Example of using the default toolkit AI resources in AL AzureOpenAI.SetManagedResourceAuthorization(Enum::"AOAI Model Type"::"Chat Completions",AzureOpenAIAccountName,AzureOpenAIApiKey,AOAIDeployments.GetGPT4oLatest()); To use your own subscription, authenticate it with the SetAuthorization method. // Example of using your own Azure OpenAI subscription in AL AzureOpenAI.SetAuthorization(Enum::"AOAI Model Type"::"Chat Completions",GetEndpoint(),GetDeployment(),GetApiKey()); This AI billing model isn't designed to replace the existing Marketplace monetization pathway for publishers who create Business Central apps. Instead, it offers another option that simplifies AI consumption for customers and partners. ISVs can use the Marketplace monetization option to monetize their IP. Business Value: A key feature of the developer tools for Copilot in Business Central is that publishers in their Marketplace apps use large language models through Microsoft-managed Azure OpenAI resources when they extend Copilot in Business Central. This approach eliminates the need for customers to independently get and manage Azure OpenAI subscriptions. Using the Business Central AI resources is the default and recommended approach. However, some partners or customers might have special requirements that require them to use their own Azure OpenAI subscription when running the feature in production or when developing and testing in sandboxes, which is also supported in the developer tools for Copilot in Business Central. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically
